title: Reverse Bits
statement: Given a 32-bit integer value, return the integer represented by its bits in reverse order.
Treat the input as exactly 32 bits when moving bits from low positions to high positions.
constraints: 0 <= n <= 2^31 - 1 for this runner-safe problem bank entry.
The reversed 32-bit value for provided tests fits in a signed 32-bit integer.
